biggestGap.lighting: hero / phone_hud: the shade is crushed and not blue. Shadowed EQ pavers measure 30,25,27, where the bible shade tint #46526A is 70,82,106 and GTA VI shade stays open and cool under a warm key. The sun path no longer clips (0.2% of hero >= 245, was about 12%), and the warm key, long streaks and rim are right. The fill is now too weak, which leaves near-black wedges on a 5:1 bible ratio that reads closer to 12:1.
biggestGap.time_of_day: hero_night: the plaza is still lit evenly edge to edge. It is brighter than r6 (mid 122,104,78 vs 105,87,64), with no readable pools. The lamp poles glow white over their bottom 2 m (y=300-370 luma 199-227), and the bench legs blow out (226,205,175). Lit office floors are flat beige and grey slabs with no interior hot spots, so they read as a block mosaic rather than a city at night.
biggestGap.palette: Every golden-hour frame sits in one lilac-grey haze: hero inlet 112,100,95, mends sky 171,165,170, kings_park skyline 124,119,128. CBD bitumen is still blue (street_sgt 44,51,69, shops 42,49,66), and the curtain walls are royal blue (street_sgt 76,93,118). The bible wants warm amber sunlit faces, teal water and blue-grey shade. None of the road or GL constants from the last two rounds landed (world/index.js line 37, towers.js line 132).
biggestGap.materials: EQ paving is a uniform 0.6 x 0.3 m stretcher grid that reads as a car park (hero, hero_back, hero_noon). The real quay (tricia1) has small charcoal setts in fan arcs and wide limestone bands. At noon the three-tone checker (step 0.72 / 0.88) is loud. Shopfronts are still grey panels behind the new glyph sign boxes (street_sgt, shops), the Mends shelter is a blank 122,126,129 slab for the 4th round, and night windows are untextured cream tiles.
biggestGap.vegetation: aerial: Kings Park is still a bald grey-mauve striped hill, 114,109,113 and 83,86,99, where it should be dark olive canopy. That makes 5 rounds. The bush() surface has no distance term and the clumps fade out at 1100-1500 m. kings_park: about 40 bright-lime lollipop euc2 trees in rows along Mounts Bay Rd (119,120,81), and pale pin trunks (eb2 0xa89a88) under the canopy. The street planes in shops and street_sgt are good.
biggestGap.architecture: bridge_skyline / river_cbd / aerial: mid and far towers are smooth flat-colour prisms with no floor striping, no base-to-crown value gradient and no setbacks. Low-rise blocks in the aerial view are beige boxes (155,143,140) with bare roofs. eq2 shows clear floor banding and darker podiums at this range.
biggestGap.characters: The occlusion regression is fixed: the player is fully visible in hero, hero_noon and hero_night. Now the crowd is visibly cloned. hero_noon and hero_back show 3 identical green-shirt, jeans, blonde women in frame at once, because the round-robin pick() runs over a 9-avatar pool. hero_night walkers are still lit like day. In hero_back the player shows no sun-shadow streak, while the bench and the walkers do.
biggestGap.composition: The player is now clear at x 0.40 in every hero frame. In hero the upper-left 40% is still empty sky over flat water and every palm sits to the right (4th round). The brightest value is the sun glare on the paving at frame right, not the player or the bridge.
biggestGap.atmosphere: The sky and clouds are the strongest element. The water is still brushed parallel stripes to the horizon (mends, river_cbd, hero_back left), with no slick or cat's-paw variation (sea.js has no slick term). From South Perth the skyline is ghosted: mends tower 154,150,155 against sky 171,165,170 is dL about 17, worse than r6, even though the far facade albedo cut landed. eq2 and kpview have towers at 0.5-0.7x sky luma.
biggestGap.ui: phone_hud: unchanged from r6. The pink and yellow bars sit at full opacity over the far shore on the boot frame (hud.js line 139 calmT > 4, ui.css line 64 .calm 0). ENTER shows a full-strength pink ring with no vehicle in reach.
biggestGap.mobile: phone_hud: the idle walker is gone from the JUMP rect and the player is clear of the thumbs. The remaining gap is the ENTER ring and bars at full strength, plus a large unlit dark tower slab on the right. Text is legible.
biggestGap.artefacts: The P0 shadow fix landed: hero_noon now has a bench shadow (58,61,67 against 141,139,136 paver) and the player has a contact shadow. Still broken: night pole and bench-leg glow; no player shadow streak in hero_back; brushed water stripes; an 8 px grey near-plane column at the shops right edge (a lamp pole about 0.5 m from the lens, also in r6); a hard flat world-edge plane at the aerial horizon; KP pin trunks.
biggestGap.real_game: hero and hero_back would pass for a mid-budget open-world game screenshot. The CBD shots break that read: street_sgt shows 0 moving cars and 2 peds on 6-lane St Georges Tce at 17:00, and shops shows 1 car and 0 peds on an empty arterial. Add the bald Kings Park, cloned peds and the night block mosaic, and the set still reads as a tech demo.

fixes.area: Kings Park bald at range (5th round, never landed)
fixes.problem: aerial: the KP massif is 114,109,113 / 83,86,99, a grey-mauve striped hill. mends: the KP hill is 96,103,123. kpview shows a continuous dark olive canopy. surfaces.js bush() (lines 59-74) has no distance term, so beyond the clump fade (props.js line 149, fade [1100,1500] on high) the ground shows pale Bassendean sand plus mowing-like streaks. Per the rubric, a dimension below 5 for two rounds is P0. Vegetation has been at 5 for this long, and this is its single biggest lever.
fixes.fix: surfaces.js bush: add a far-canopy blend after line 70: float fc = smoothstep(700.0, 1300.0, length(vWthPos - cameraPosition)); col = mix(col, vec3(0.045, 0.055, 0.032) * (0.7 + 0.5 * big), fc); s.ao = mix(s.ao, 0.65, fc); s.rough = mix(s.rough, 0.97, fc). If the baked SURFACES programs have no vWthPos, apply the same mix in ground.js where the bush layer is sampled (ground.js already computes world-space luv for the lamp map at line 190). props.js line 149: clump fade high [1100,1500] -> [1400,1900], so the cards overlap the blend band.

fixes.area: empty CBD streets: cost went up, visible life did not
fixes.problem: street_sgt shows 0 moving cars and 2 peds; shops shows 1 car and 0 peds. Draw calls rose 757 -> 1169 (street_sgt) and 256 -> 646 (shops) from r6 to r7, so the extra sgt walkers and primed cars cost calls but land out of frame. T.prime (traffic.js lines 108-125) filters on distance from the FOCUS (15-180 m), not along the camera's view, and requires cos > 0.3. peds S.prime (peds.js line 75) skips 30% of walkers (Math.random() > 0.7) and needs cos > 0.55 within 140 m of the focus.
fixes.fix: traffic.js T.prime: keep candidates whose camera-space depth (dot(q-cp, cf)) is 40-220 m and whose lateral offset is under 0.6*depth (that is, inside a 62-degree FOV). Drop the focus-distance test. Lane spacing 14 -> 10 m. Add a static parked-car row (one InstancedMesh per KINDS body, no AI, no physics): 1 car per 9 m on kerb lanes of St Georges Tce, The Esplanade and Barrack St within 300 m of the camera, 55% occupancy. That gives near-free street density. peds.js S.prime: skip share 0.3 -> 0.05, cos 0.55 -> 0.35, d < 140 -> camera depth 10-120 m. Pull the sgt count back on high 22 -> 16 so calls stay flat.

fixes.area: EQ paving reads as a car park; noon checker

fixes.problem: hero_noon and hero_back each show 3 identical green-top, jeans, blonde women in one frame, and hero shows 2. pick() (peds.js line 32) cycles a 9-avatar pool round-robin, and S.prime then gathers walkers of the same loop in front of the camera. With no per-instance clothing variation, any 2 clones within 30 m read as a demo.
fixes.fix: avatars.js instance(): clone the top and bottom clothing materials per instance (same program, so no new shader compiles). Apply one of 6 hue/value tints: color.offsetHSL(dh in [-0.5,0.5], ds in [-0.2,0.1], dl in [-0.15,0.1]), seeded by instance index. Leave skin and hair materials untouched, except a hair value jitter of ±0.1. peds.js pick(): shuffle the pool once with a seeded Fisher-Yates. In S.prime, reject a waypoint if a walker with the same avatar is already within 25 m.

fixes.area: near-plane clipping column in shops (also r6)
fixes.problem: shops: an 8 px full-height grey column at the right edge (121,123,129). A lamp pole or wall about 0.5 m from the lens is being cut by the near plane.
fixes.fix: Add a camera-near dither fade: props, lamps and street furniture within 1.2 m of the camera discard by screen-door dither (alpha = smoothstep(0.4, 1.2, dist)). This is a common open-world trick and costs one varying. Or, cheaper for QA, shift the views.json shops cam 1.5 m left.

regressions.what: Night plaza got brighter, not darker: mid 105,87,64 -> 122,104,78. The pool-to-gap contrast is still about 1.6.
Draw calls rose with no visible gain: street_sgt 757 -> 1169 (+54%, 0 cars and 2 peds in frame) and shops 256 -> 646 (+152%, 1 car, 0 peds). Primed actors land out of frame.
The South Perth skyline is more ghosted: dL about 26 -> 17, despite the far-facade albedo cut.
Shade crushed toward black: hero shadow paver 52,41,36 -> 30,25,27. It is cooler, which was the goal, but too dark.
Visible avatar clones: 3 identical green-shirt women per frame, now exposed because the player is no longer occluded.
